title: Rockland Blucher - Parchment
description: Spring has finally sprung, time to put away the boots and heavy dress shoes. We have the perfect antidote for your footwear fatigue... the new Rockland Blucher. This summer stunner is handcrafted in Maine from classic nubuck cowhide and luxurious split suede and fully lined with tan cowhide lining. The lightweight Dalton outsoles in brick red give these a unique but traditional look. The Rockland Blucher is the perfect Spring/Summer dress shoe - lightweight and comfortable in vibrant summer colors. For a refined look pair with a navy or khaki cotton suit or a blue seersucker suit. Dress it down with chinos or navy seersucker slacks. Blake Construction. Made in Maine, USA.
